msg: I felt like the taller gnome provided the better reward more consistently but it seemed to need a 'refresh' every now and then by selecting the shorter gnome. I don't think the colours mattered very much but the other factor being left or right I believe had some impact. I tended to think that the gnome on the right side of the screen provided better rewards. However, due to the limited time scales and the constant bombardment of numbers, I think the best strategy is not to overthink it and experiment for yourself.    In summary : Taller gnome, colour didn't matter, side seemed to be better on the right but unsure of any of this. Good luck!
